arxiv-1806-07304.title: Dynamic Multi-Level Multi-Task Learning for Sentence Simplification
arxiv-1806-07304.creator: Han Guo Ramakanth Pasunuru Mohit Bansal
arxiv-1806-07304.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Han Guo Ramakanth Pasunuru Mohit Bansal. Sentence simplification aims to improve readability and understandability, based on several operations such as splitting, deletion, and paraphrasing. However, a valid simplified sentence should also be logically entailed by its input sentence. In this work, we first present a strong pointer-copy mechanism based sequence-to-sequence sentence simplification model, and then improve its entailment and paraphrasing capabilities via multi-task learning with related auxiliary tasks of entailment and paraphrase generation.

arxiv-1905-06873.title: DAS3H: Modeling Student Learning and Forgetting for Optimally Scheduling Distributed Practice of Skills
arxiv-1905-06873.creator: Fabrice Popineau, Yolaine Bourda, Jill-Jênn Vie
arxiv-1905-06873.description: Abstract Spaced repetition is among the most studied learning strategies in the cognitive science literature. It consists in temporally distributing exposure to an information so as to improve long-term memorization. Providing students with an adaptive and personalized distributed practice schedule would benefit more than just a generic scheduler.

arxiv-2109-06458.title: A Note on Knowledge Distillation Loss Function for Object Classification
arxiv-2109-06458.creator: Defang Chen
arxiv-2109-06458.description: Abstract This research note provides a quick introduction to the knowledge distillation loss function used in object classification. In particular, we discuss its connection to a previously proposed logits matching loss function. We further treat knowledge distillation as a specific form of output regularization and demonstrate its connection to label smoothing and entropy-based regularization.

arxiv-2110-13032.title: Paradigm Shift in Language Modeling: Revisiting CNN for Modeling Sanskrit Originated Bengali and Hindi Language
arxiv-2110-13032.creator: Chowdhury Rafeed Rahman, MD. Hasibur Rahman, Mohammad Rafsan, Samiha Zakir, Mohammed Eunus Ali, Rafsanjani Muhammod
arxiv-2110-13032.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chowdhury Rafeed Rahman, MD. Hasibur Rahman, Mohammad Rafsan, Samiha Zakir, Mohammed Eunus Ali, Rafsanjani Muhammod. Though there has been a large body of recent works in language modeling (LM) for high resource languages such as English and Chinese, the area is still unexplored for low resource languages like Bengali and Hindi.

arxiv-2211-14732.title: Deep representation learning: Fundamentals, Perspectives, Applications, and Open Challenges
arxiv-2211-14732.creator: Kourosh T. Baghaei §, Amirreza payandeh §, Pooya Fayyazsanavi, Shahram Rahimi, Zhiqian Chen, Somayeh Bakhtiari Ramezani
arxiv-2211-14732.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kourosh T. Baghaei §, Amirreza payandeh §, Pooya Fayyazsanavi, Shahram Rahimi, Zhiqian Chen, Somayeh Bakhtiari Ramezani. Machine Learning algorithms have had a profound impact on the field of computer science over the past few decades. These algorithms’ performance is greatly influenced by the representations that are derived from the data in the learning process. The representations learned in a successful learning process should be concise, discrete, meaningful, and able to be applied across a variety of tasks.

arxiv-2411-12431.title: CV-Cities: Advancing Cross-View Geo-Localization in Global Cities
arxiv-2411-12431.creator: Gaoshuang Huang, Yang Zhou*, Luying Zhao, Wenjian Gan
arxiv-2411-12431.description: Abstract Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL), which involves matching and retrieving satellite images to determine the geographic location of a ground image, is crucial in GNSS-constrained scenarios. However, this task faces significant challenges due to substantial viewpoint discrepancies, the complexity of localization scenarios, and the need for global localization.

arxiv-2412-19745.title: IR side of bounds on Theories with Spontaneously Broken Lorentz Symmetry
arxiv-2412-19745.creator: Francesco Serra, Leonardo G. Trombetta
arxiv-2412-19745.description: Abstract In nature, some UV features of dynamics are reflected in IR quantities. In fully relativistic theories, this connection can be probed through the analyticity properties of scattering amplitudes, allowing one to understand which IR theories respect the UV assumptions of quantum field theory.

arxiv-2601-13077.title: Some results on the 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} -stability of surfaces with boundary Thanks: The author was supported by the National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) grant funded by the Korea government (No. RS-2023-00214167).
arxiv-2601-13077.creator: Sanghun Lee
arxiv-2601-13077.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate the geometric properties associated with the 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} -stability of surfaces with boundary whose null expansion satisfies Θ + = h ≥ 0 \Theta^{+}=h\geq 0 . First, we show that a 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} -stable hypersurface with free boundary admits a metric of positive scalar curvature with minimal boundary under suitable conditions.

arxiv-2602-13030.title: Resource-Efficient Gesture Recognition through Convexified Attention
arxiv-2602-13030.creator: Daniel Schwartz, Dario Salvucci, Yusuf Osmanlioglu, Richard Vallett, Genevieve Dion, Ali Shokoufandeh
arxiv-2602-13030.description: Abstract Wearable e-textile interfaces require gesture recognition capabilities but face severe constraints in power consumption, computational capacity, and form factor that make traditional deep learning impractical. While lightweight architectures like MobileNet improve efficiency, they still demand thousands of parameters, limiting deployment on textile-integrated platforms.

pmc-10687994.title: Biological properties of polycaprolactone and barium titanate composite in biomedical applications
pmc-10687994.creator: Sabreen Waleed Ibrahim, Thekra Ismael Hamad, Julfikar Haider
pmc-10687994.description: The ceramic-polymer composite materials are widely known for their exceptional mechanical and biological properties. Polycaprolactone (PCL) is a biodegradable polymer material extensively used in various biomedical applications. At the same time, barium titanate (BT), a ceramic material, exhibits piezoelectric properties similar to bone, which is essential for osseointegration.

pmc-10752605.title: Renal failure following insulin purging in atypical anorexia nervosa and type 1 diabetes mellitus
pmc-10752605.creator: Caroline Rometsch, Martina Guthoff, Stephan Zipfel, Andreas Stengel
pmc-10752605.description: ObjectiveAnorexia nervosa (AN) and atypical anorexia nervosa (AAN) are severe and complex eating disorders that can be prevalent among individuals with type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM). Insulin purging, characterized by the intentional underuse / omission of insulin to control weight, is under-recognized in medicine and is a purging strategy of patients with AN or AAN and comorbid T1DM.

pmc-11344359.title: Evaluation of the management of a first crisis of atrial fibrillation in a group of Cameroon’s urban setting subjects
pmc-11344359.creator: Loïc Alban Mbosso Tasong, CN Nganou-Gnindjio, Honoré Kemnang Yemele, Jules Thierry Elong, Laura Murielle Makowa Kuate, Simeon Kuissu, Alain Patrick Menanga
pmc-11344359.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common arrhythmia encountered in clinical practice. When atrial fibrillation is first diagnosed, it tends to be permanent and associated with significant morbidity and mortality. We aimed to study the management of a first episode of atrial fibrillation in a group of patients in Yaounde, Cameroon.

pmc-11403122.title: Neurosarcoidosis: Clinical, biological, and MRI presentation of central nervous system disease in a national multicenter cohort
pmc-11403122.creator: Amélie Dos santos, Edouard Courtin, Aurélie Ruet, Pierre Duffau, Guillaume Mathey, Ines Bekkour, Jonathan Ciron, Laure Michel, François Xavier Blanc, Jésus Aguilar, Pascal Lejeune, Guillaume Marc, David Laplaud, Armelle Magot, Mohamed Hamidou, Sandrine Wiertlewski
pmc-11403122.description: IntroductionNeurosarcoidosis (NS) is a systemic inflammatory granulomatous disease affecting of patients with sarcoidosis. Its diagnosis is difficult as there is no specific test for it. Because of its rarity, the management of NS has so far only been described in case series and short retrospective cohorts.

pmc-11641607.title: PTH1R Suppressed Apoptosis of Mesenchymal Progenitors in Mandibular Growth
pmc-11641607.creator: Chen Cui, Chuang Lu, Yanling Cai, Yuhua Xiong, Yihong Duan, Kaiwen Lan, Yi Fan, Xuedong Zhou, Xi Wei, Sang-Bae Han
pmc-11641607.description: Genetic abnormalities of the parathyroid hormone 1 receptor (PTH1R) lead to profound craniomaxillofacial bone and dentition defects on account of inappropriate tissue metabolism and cellular differentiation. The coordinated activity of differentiation and viability in bone cells is indispensable for bone metabolism.

pmc-12430721.title: Genetic Polymorphisms of Invasive Ambrosia artemisiifolia L. in Localities of Slovakia Accessed by Bet v 1 Homologs Differ in Discrimination of Accessions and Show Their Outcrossing in This Area
pmc-12430721.creator: Lucia Klongová, Adam Kováčik, Veronika Štefúnová, Monika Tóthová, Jana Žiarovská
pmc-12430721.description: Ambrosia artemisiifolia is one of the invasive plants found in Europe. Research into this species is important not only in terms of environmental consequences but also in terms of human health, as it is an allergenic weed. Here, the genetic variability in the accessions of common ragweed from three localities of the Slovak Republic was analysed.

pmc-12547737.title: Universal Subconstructs of a Healthy Diet for Children and Adolescents: A Critical Review
pmc-12547737.creator: Teresa R Schwendler, Edward A Frongillo, Hope C Craig, Giles T Hanley-Cook, Isabela Fleury Sattamini, Chika Hayashi, Vrinda Mehra, Alissa M Pries, Kuntal Saha, Jennifer C Coates, Francesco Branca, Francesco Branca, Mauro Brero, Elaine Borghi, Jennifer Coates, Luz Maria de Regil, Edward Frongillo, Gi
pmc-12547737.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To monitor diets among children and adolescents, a thorough understanding of the underlying subconstructs of a healthy diet is needed to inform what should be measured. The aim of this study was to identify universal subconstructs of a healthy diet for children and adolescents aged 2–19 y, understand alignment with subconstructs for adults, and inform recommendations for metrics that aim to monitor the healthiness of diets among children and adolescents at global and national levels.

pmc-12735301.creator: Andrzej Perec, Elzbieta Kawecka, Wojciech Zajac, Andrea Di Schino, Shinichi Tashiro
pmc-12735301.description: Highlights What are the main findings? The cutting process circumstances evaluation by measuring the footprints angle and jet deflection angle.Quality control of the AWJ machining process was achieved by measuring the jet deflection angle. What is the implication of the main finding?

pmc-12790230.title: Efficacy of Novel Techniques Using a 4-F, 130-cm JR4.0 Catheter for Challenging Guiding Catheter Engagement
pmc-12790230.creator: Nobuo Ishiguro, Akimitsu Tanaka, Kohei Kitamura, Miyabi Ishikawa, Teppei Funasaka, Mami Fukujyu, Takeshi Mori, Makito Kaneshiro, Miyuki Ando, Kazuo Kato
pmc-12790230.description: Percutaneous coronary intervention is a mature procedure with a high success rate. However, there are rare situations in which a guiding catheter cannot engage the coronary artery ostium, such as with an anomalous aortic origin of a coronary artery or interference from a transcatheter aortic valve implantation.

pmc-13082710.title: NSUN4-mediated m5C RNA methylation protects retinal cells against excitotoxic injury via the SHH signaling pathway
pmc-13082710.creator: Yahong Li, Dian Li, Chao Geng, Ruihua Wei, Yajian Duan
pmc-13082710.description: Glaucoma, a leading global cause of blindness, is characterized by progressive retinal neuronal loss. NOP2/Sun RNA methyltransferase 4 (NSUN4), a writer of 5-methylcytosine (m5C) RNA modifications, has established roles in methylation and mitoribosome assembly, yet its function in retinal cell survival remains unexplored.

pmc-13240880.title: The effect of yttrium addition on the ratcheting behavior of magnesium
pmc-13240880.creator: Haoge Shou, Yaoyao Song, Yang Yang, Li Li, Mingjie Wang, Peng Shi, Qi Li, Huanjian Xie, Hongzhou Zhang
pmc-13240880.description: This study provides an in-depth investigation into the influence of yttrium (Y) addition on the ratcheting behavior of magnesium (Mg) alloys under asymmetric cyclic loading. Although pure Mg exhibits higher strength under quasi-static tension, the Mg–Y alloy demonstrates markedly superior resistance to ratcheting during cyclic deformation.

pmc-13441526.creator: Masanori WADA, Takeshi ASANO, Iwao YAMAKAMI, Hajime YOKOTA, Kentaro HORIGUCHI, Yoshinori HIGUCHI
pmc-13441526.description: Vertebral artery dissection is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition. However, many cases of mild vertebral artery dissection―an early disease stage―may be overlooked. 3-dimensional T1-weighted black-blood magnetic resonance imaging has recently emerged as a promising diagnostic tool, yet it remains underutilized.

pmc-13534688.title: Altered ANG/TIE gene expression in advanced ovarian cancer is not accompanied by disproportionate body water accumulation relative to perioperative fluid balance
pmc-13534688.creator: Sarah Reifenhaeuser, Katrin Stein, Stilla Frede, Eva K Egger, Alexander Mustea, Mark Coburn, Sven Klaschik, Martin Soehle, Tobias Hilbert
pmc-13534688.description: Abdominal cytoreductive surgery due to advanced-stage ovarian cancer (OC) often requires extensive fluid administration to stabilize hemodynamic conditions. Recently, systemic changes in the expression profile of Angiopoietin (ANG)/TIE axis genes have been demonstrated in those patients, raising the question whether they exhibit an inherent clinical phenotype associated with vascular dysfunction and leakage that may explain the significant perioperative fluid demands.

pmc-13609915.title: Obesity and Osteoporotic Fractures: Solving the Paradox
pmc-13609915.creator: Khushboo Agarwal, Shinjan Patra
pmc-13609915.description: Obesity is a global health issue linked to conditions like metabolic syndrome and heart disease, but its relationship with fracture risk is complex. While higher body mass index (BMI) is associated with increased bone mineral density (BMD) due to mechanical loading, it does not uniformly protect against fractures.

pmc-13648178.title: Pre-loss grief among family caregivers: An evolutionary concept analysis
pmc-13648178.creator: Ying Qian, Meng Xu, Lili Yang, Ye Song, LinYan Yao, JiaYing Wang
pmc-13648178.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to clarify the evolving characteristics of pre-loss grief among family caregivers by identifying its attributes, antecedents, consequences, and related concepts.MethodsA comprehensive literature search was conducted across English databases (PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, CINAHL, APA PsycInfo, and APA PsycArticles) and Chinese databases (China National Knowledge Infrastructure, SinoMed, VIP, and Wanfang).

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Producer The term “producer” means any person engaged in the raising and caring for livestock or poultry for slaughter. (2) Processor The term “processor” means any person engaged in the business of obtaining livestock or poultry.
